mechanism_narrative: A sharp increase in the Federal Funds Rate above 5.25% in the month preceding the prediction triggers a term premium compression, lowering discount rates and pushing up near-term equity valuations, which drives positive S&P 500 forward returns within 5 trading days.
candidate_trigger: FEDFUNDS crosses above 5.25% in the month prior to prediction
regime_hint: Rising Fed Funds Rate surprise in a restrictive policy phase
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are not statistically higher than the 30-day moving average of the pre-signal month, or term premium spread (10Y TIPS - 2Y TIPS) widens by > 10bps in the following month.

mechanism_narrative: Persistent declines in the CPIAUCSL inflation index below 3% for two consecutive months signal disinflation, prompting the Fed to hold rates steady and reducing real discount rates, which supports equity price appreciation over the next 60 trading days.
candidate_trigger: CPIAUCSL falls below 3.0 for two consecutive months
regime_hint: Stable inflation regime with gradual cooling
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns underperform the 30-day rolling average of the preceding 60 days, or the 10-day moving average of the 2-week TIPS breakeven is not lower than the 20-day SPX breakeven.

mechanism_narrative: A sudden surge in employment growth (PAYEMS) above 200,000 jobs in a month is accompanied by rising consumer confidence (HOUST), jointly lowering risk aversion and pushing up equity valuations, producing positive S&P 500 forward returns within 20 trading days.
candidate_trigger: PAYEMS > 200,000 and HOUST increases in the same month
regime_hint: Labor market strengthening with improving sentiment
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are negative despite the trigger, or the joint IC of PAYEMS and HOUST is <0.05 over a 6-month window.

mechanism_narrative: A sharp contraction in industrial production (INDPRO) of more than 5% month-over-month, followed by a rebound in retail sales (PAYEMS) above trend, indicates a turning point in supply-demand dynamics that supports equity price gains in the next 5 days.
candidate_trigger: INDPRO falls >5% MoM and PAYEMS rises above its 3-month moving average in the following month
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are negative in the first week after the signal, or the IC of INDPRO and PAYEMS is not statistically significant (p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A multi-month decline in industrial production (INDPRO) below 100 suggests weakening supply capacity, which amplifies demand pressures and supports a positive S&P 500 forward return over 60 trading days unless deflationary risks materialize.
regime_hint: Structural supply-side weakness in a growth-restricted environment
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are persistently negative over the 60-day horizon, or the 10-day TIPS-SPX spread widens by > 30bps.

mechanism_narrative: A sharp rise in unemployment (UNRATE) above 4.5% for two consecutive months indicates labor market softening, raising risk aversion and compressing equity valuations, which typically produces negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 days.
candidate_trigger: UNRATE crosses above 4.5% for two consecutive months
regime_hint: Labor market cooling in a non-recessionary economy
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns exceed the 30-day moving average of the pre-signal period, or the 5-day moving average of the 10-day TIPS-SPX spread turns negative.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in RSAFS demand for Treasury securities below 2.5 billion in a month signals excess liquidity in the financial system, which typically precedes a rate cut cycle and supports positive S&P 500 forward returns within 5 days.
regime_hint: Financial market liquidity build-up in a holding pattern
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are flat or negative during the subsequent 30-day window, or the 5-day moving average of the 3-month TIPS rate is not lower than the 3-month SPX rate.

mechanism_narrative: A sharp contraction in consumer confidence (HOUST) below 900 coinciding with a sustained drop in industrial production (INDPRO) below 105 suggests dual supply-side shocks that depress equity risk premia, producing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 days in this regime.
candidate_trigger: HOUST < 900 and INDPRO < 105 for two consecutive months
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are not significantly below the 30-day rolling average during the 20-day window following the signal, or the joint IC of HOUST and INDPRO is >0.10.
